definitions.meaning: Equally, likewise, in like manner, together

quotations.old_english: Forðon ic ne mæg eal ða monigfealdan yfel endemes areccan
quotations.english: because I cannot equally reckon all the manifest evils

quotations.old_english: Ne mæg hió ealle endemest gescínan
quotations.english: nor can she equally shine upon all

source_text: ende-mes, endemest, ændemes, ændemest; adv. Equally, likewise, in like manner, together; p&a-short;r&i-short;ter :-- Forðon ic ne mæg eal ða monigfealdan yfel endemes areccan because I cannot equally reckon all the manifest evils, Ors. 2, 5; Bos. 49, 11: 3, 10; Bos. 69, 36. Ne mæg hió ealle endemest gescínan nor can she equally shine upon all, Bt. 41, 1; Fox 244, 9.
